name: zcode-commandcode-private
description: Command Code Provider API integration for ZCode: live model catalog with SWR cache and circuit breaker, streaming generation, multi-account rotation on 429/401, and a per-account usage/credits/plan dashboard. Ported from wjf1/dsh-commandcode (MIT).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 ZCode 的 Command Code Provider API 集成：带 SWR 缓存与断路器的实时模型目录、流式生成、429/401 多账号自动轮换、按账号的用量/额度/套餐看板。移植自 wjf1/dsh-commandcode (MIT)。
